name: Staff of Swarming Insects

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

magic.attunement: by a Bard, Cleric, Druid, Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard

last.text: dissolves into a swarm of insects that flies away

powers.name: Insect Cloud
powers.text: Magic action, 1 charge: harmless flying insects fill a 30-ft Emanation around you for 10 minutes; the area is Heavily Obscured.

summary: 10 charges: Giant Insect (4), Insect Plague (5), or a cloud of insects that blots out sight.
text: The staff holds 10 charges, regaining 1d6 + 4 at each dawn; spending the final one means rolling 1d20, and on a 1, insects swarm over the staff, devour it and scatter. Spells: while holding it, spend charges to cast Insect Plague (5 charges) or Giant Insect (4 charges) with your spell save DC. Insect Cloud: as a Magic action, spend 1 charge to fill a 30-foot Emanation around you with a buzzing swarm of harmless flying bugs. For 10 minutes the swarm makes the area Heavily Obscured for everyone but you and moves along with you; a strong wind scatters it and ends the effect.
